Nutrimix Powder

What age range is the Little Joys NutriMix suitable for?

Nutrimix is suitable for every child of age 2 years & above.

Can I replace my child's meal with Nutrimix?

We suggest using Nutrimix as a supplement to a well-balanced diet. Nutrimix is not a replacement for a meal for children.

How to prepare 1 serving of Nutrimix?

Mix 2 scoops (30 g) of the nutrition powder with 200 ml of lukewarm or cold milk to prepare 1 serving of Nutrimix.
